title: Digital caliper measuring a concrete sample
visual_facts: A rough gray cylindrical sample lies beside a digital caliper.
The caliper jaws span the sample's width.
Its black scale has yellow markings and a digital display that appears to read 101.55.
The sample and caliper rest on a clear plastic sheet over a dark work surface.
spatial_relations: The sample lies parallel to the caliper scale, between its jaws.
uncertainties: The display units are not clearly legible.
The sample material is not explicitly identified in the image.
